description: API access, one page of truth (GET /v1/access): the products one key rents (RPC, proofs, decoded events, the coordination API, grades), each with its calls, its price per 1,000 in GRID and USDC, its free allowance and limits, and what it measured over the last 24 h; the chains and methods of the RPC gateway; how a key is topped up. With view "package": the Taifoon product package on the same key and balance — Taifoon RPC, Taifoon GPU, Taifoon TEE — each with its units, list prices (USDC per 1M units; GRID pays half), free allowance, status (live | simulator), how to buy, resell and contribute (the package section of GET /v1/access). With view "key": your key’s permissions, budgets, balance and rate (GET /v1/access/key). With view "usage": what your key used per product family over window 1d | 7d | 30d | month (GET /v1/access/usage). With view "reseller": a reseller tenant’s children, their usage, what they owe and the margin (GET /v1/access/reseller). key, usage and reseller need your key (api_key, or the X-API-Key header on this server).
name: taifoon_access
